small_list_rule: At ~2 confirmed records there is no defensible statistical A/B inference, audience segmentation or conversion lift claim.
reporting: When and only when sends are approved, separate observed/unknown/estimated. Do not report a 0 when an outcome was not measured.
privacy: No addresses, full referrer URLs, cookies, device fingerprint, unique query tokens or raw purchase IDs in public output.
